name: Tuscany
about: Spring and fall are classic (harvest in Sep–Oct, wildflowers in spring), summer is hot, dry and busiest.
overview: Cypress-lined hills, medieval hill towns, and some of Italy's most celebrated wine country.
costOverview: A casual trattoria meal and a basic wine tasting stay reasonable — private winery tours and flagship estates are where the real spending happens.

specialSeasons.text: Grape and olive harvest is underway across the countryside, the most atmospheric time to visit wine country.
Wildflowers and poppies carpet the countryside in spring bloom.
